body:
Part 1 of 3 from the friction in work run 972864856add02fd on task:10e5b94213c1e788. Parts 2 and 3 depend on this one, since all three edit the same docs.

**Do.** `Type::method` (e.g. `language::rust_refs.Refs::new`) resolves to `Refs<'a>::new` in every name-taking command when only one impl matches.
- Add `store.without_generics(name)`: drop each balanced `<…>` group that follows an identifier (`Refs<'a>::new` → `Refs::new`). Leave names starting with `<` (trait impls such as `<Failure as From<…>>::from`) unchanged.
- Add `store.names_loosely(s, input)`: like `store.names`, but compares against `without_generics(s.name)`.
- `crate.Store::resolve` and `rust_submit.rust_named`: exact matches first; loose matches only when nothing matches exactly. This covers `view`, `inspect`, `refs`, `impact`, `delete` (through `resolve`) and patch headers plus `*** Add: m.Type::fn` containers (through `rust_symbol`, `rust_container`, `rust_container_in`).
- More than one match: the existing E1002 already lists the full names; no change.

**Docs.**
- `store.RUST_BRIEF`: after "A method is `<module>.<Type>::<fn>`" add "generics may be left out (`Refs::new`) when one impl matches".
- `solace-cli/src/reference.txt`: say a method name may leave out generics.
- `specs/03-protocol.md`, `view` row: the generic-free name match.
- `DECISIONS.md`: add a new decision for these submit/naming changes (check the last number first; the same-project extract tasks also plan one). Parts 2 and 3 add their points to it.

**Tests** (`store::read_tests`, `store::submit_tests`): `view` and `*** Update: m.Refs::new` reach `Refs<'a>::new`; `impl Foo<u8>` and `impl Foo<i32>` with the same method give E1002 listing both; an exact name still wins over a loose match.

**Out of scope.** Agent-side mistakes from that run; Gleam naming.
title: names: Rust methods without generics
